title: OPTDRV-006: `mmap()` results are stored without checking for `MAP_FAILED`
summary: OPTDRV-006: `mmap()` results are stored without checking for `MAP_FAILED`. A failed mapping is later read as image memory in `ReadFrame()` and later passed to `munmap()`, which can crash or corrupt exposure output under memory pressure or invalid buffer FDs. Check each mapping, unwind any mappings made for the request, and fail `StartCapture()` cleanly. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied.

resolution.evidence: 20261024202957-6bd9-fix-ccd-rpi/verification.md: mmap MAP_FAILED checked, shared plane fds mapped once with offsets; review-verified
